items.title: Cowboys and Cardinals Square Off in Preseason Nightcap at State Farm Stadium
items.one_line: Dallas (1-0 preseason) faces Arizona (1-1) tonight at 10 p.m. ET on NFL Network, with most starters resting to spotlight the QB battle between Sam Howell and Joe Milton III plus rookies like linebacker Jaishawn Barham.

items.title: Falcons' Michael Penix Jr. Cleared for Full Practice After Knee Recovery
items.one_line: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Penix is cleared for full 11-on-11 practice starting Monday after an ACL tear that sidelined him through 2025, ramping up a QB competition with Tua Tagovailoa after Atlanta's 34-6 preseason rout of Indianapolis.

items.title: Rookie QB Jack Strand Powers Falcons' 34-6 Preseason Rout of Colts
items.one_line: Undrafted Jack Strand went 12 of 17 for 212 yards, a TD pass to Cash Jones, and a 16-yard rushing score as Atlanta piled up 461 yards; Cooper Rush started 10 of 11 for 86 yards.

items.title: Colts Defense Shines in Joint Practices with Falcons
items.one_line: Indianapolis and Atlanta held joint practices in Westfield, Indiana, where the Colts defense disrupted Atlanta's QBs, including mixed results for Tua Tagovailoa and limited reps from Michael Penix Jr.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy's Mixed Preseason Debut Steals Vikings-Ravens Spotlight
items.one_line: Baltimore beat Minnesota 13-3 at U.S. Bank Stadium; McCarthy started 5-of-10 for 81 yards with a 50-yard strike to Tai Felton before red-zone misses, as Lamar Jackson sat after joint practices.

items.title: Texans Explore Trade for Ravens Receiver Rashod Bateman
items.one_line: League sources say Houston inquired about Bateman after placing Jayden Higgins on season-ending IR; Bateman is signed through 2029, and the Ravens notified the NFL about a June family-violence case still under league review.

items.title: Sanders Shines Early as Browns Lose to Bills in QB Battle
items.one_line: Buffalo beat Cleveland 31-7 at Huntington Bank Field; Shedeur Sanders went 9-of-11 for 74 yards with a TD and an interception before halftime, while Deshaun Watson was 5-of-12 for 35 yards with a pick amid home boos.

items.title: Josh Allen Tops Multiple ESPN QB Rankings for 2026 Season
items.one_line: ESPN lists and a poll of executives, coaches, and scouts rank Buffalo's Josh Allen as the top quarterback heading into 2026, ahead of Lamar Jackson, Patrick Mahomes, and Joe Burrow.

items.title: Panthers Roll Past Jaguars 34-17 in Preseason Win
items.one_line: Carolina beat Jacksonville on Friday night behind Jimmy Horn Jr.'s 20.58 mph 39-yard end-around and Ryan Fitzgerald's 61-yard field goal; Bryce Young sat mostly out, with Kenny Pickett throwing a touchdown.

items.title: Caleb Williams Suited Up for Bears-Bengals Preseason Game
items.one_line: Caleb Williams dressed for tonight's preseason matchup at Paycor Stadium; Ben Johnson said he will play as needed to run a full night-game routine after this week's joint practice, while Zac Taylor rests most Bengals starters.

items.title: Bengals Rookie Colbie Young Scores First NFL Touchdown in Preseason Win Push
items.one_line: Fourth-round pick Colbie Young hauled in a 17-yard TD from Josh Johnson with 4:25 left in the second quarter of Saturday night's Bears-Bengals preseason game, capping a 59-yard drive.

items.title: Joe Burrow Sets High Stakes for Bengals' 2026 Rebound
items.one_line: After a 6-11 finish, Burrow told ESPN he sees 2026 as make-or-break, pointing to extensions for himself, Tee Higgins, and Ja'Marr Chase plus additions like Boye Mafe and Dexter Lawrence.

items.title: Bengals Rookie Colbie Young Scores First NFL Touchdown in Preseason Win Push
items.one_line: Fourth-round pick Colbie Young from Georgia caught a 17-yard TD from Josh Johnson late in the second quarter Saturday, boosting his roster hopes alongside Dohnte Meyers.

items.title: Caleb Williams Suited Up for Bears-Bengals Preseason Game
items.one_line: Chicago's Caleb Williams dressed for limited night-game reps at Paycor Stadium after a joint practice this week, while Bengals coach Zac Taylor rests most of his starters.

items.title: Sanders Shines Early as Browns Lose to Bills in QB Battle
items.one_line: Cleveland lost 31-7; Shedeur Sanders went 9-of-11 for 74 yards, one TD, and one interception before halftime, while Deshaun Watson was 5-of-12 for 35 yards with a pick as coach Todd Monken weighs the starter.

items.title: NFL Player Dae’Quan Wright Warms Up While in College Transfer Portal
items.one_line: Undrafted Browns tight end Dae’Quan Wright, No. 88, warmed up for the Bills preseason game after a Louisiana court TRO let him enter the portal; Todd Monken said he was cleared as a precaution but didn’t play.

items.title: Cowboys and Cardinals Square Off in Preseason Nightcap at State Farm Stadium
items.one_line: Dallas (1-0) faces Arizona tonight at 10 p.m. ET on NFL Network, with most starters resting so Brian Schottenheimer can evaluate the Sam Howell–Joe Milton III QB battle and rookies like Jaishawn Barham.

items.title: Bo Nix Shines in Preseason Return from Broken Ankle
items.one_line: Nix completed 6 of 9 for 76 yards and a touchdown Friday vs. Green Bay, including a 35-yarder to Jaylen Waddle and a 21-yard score to RJ Harvey, in his first game since a January ankle fracture.

items.title: Lions Edge Commanders 17-13 in Preseason Thriller with Daniels Debut
items.one_line: Detroit beat Washington 17-13 on Saturday behind rushing scores including Josh Dobbs; Jayden Daniels played three snaps (0-for-1, a sack) in his preseason debut with Terry McLaurin and Stefon Diggs.

items.title: Commanders-Lions Preseason Clash Features Daniels, Rests Goff
items.one_line: Jared Goff sat for Detroit's only home preseason game, handing the backup battle to Josh Dobbs and rookie Luke Altmyer while Washington expected limited snaps from Daniels, McLaurin, and Diggs.

items.title: Packers Dominate Broncos 33-13 in Preseason at Mile High
items.one_line: Green Bay evened its preseason record at 1-1; Jordan Love opened with a TD to MarShawn Lloyd and rookie kicker Trey Smack hit all four field goals including a 59-yarder.

items.title: Packers Rookie Cisse Limps Off but Shows Quick Recovery Signs
items.one_line: Second-round corner Brandon Cisse left Friday's game vs. Denver after a kickoff-return tweak, then returned to the sideline for drills and a stationary bike with Matt LaFleur checking in.

items.title: Fans Slam Broncos and Packers Backup QBs After Preseason Loss
items.one_line: Jarrett Stidham went 9 of 15 for 82 yards with an interception (47.1 rating) for Denver, and Packers fans also piled on veteran backup Tyrod Taylor after Friday's exhibition.

items.title: Colts Kicking Battle Tilts Toward Shrader After Strong Preseason Game
items.one_line: In Saturday's 34-6 loss, Spencer Shrader went 2-for-2 from 48 and 53 yards while Blake Grupe missed a 36-yarder; Shane Steichen called it a big decision as Shrader sits 4-of-4 in preseason games.

items.title: Rookie QB Jack Strand Powers Falcons' 34-6 Preseason Rout of Colts
items.one_line: Atlanta dominated at Lucas Oil Stadium as Jack Strand threw for 212 yards and two total TDs; Indianapolis was on the wrong end of 461 Falcons yards.

items.title: Panthers Roll Past Jaguars 34-17 in Preseason Win
items.one_line: Jacksonville fell Friday night as Carolina backups and rookies, including Jimmy Horn Jr. and kicker Ryan Fitzgerald, powered a 34-17 result with most Jaguars and Panthers starters sitting.

items.title: Chiefs Rookie R Mason Thomas Impresses in Preseason Debut
items.one_line: The second-round edge from Oklahoma deflected a key third-down pass and showed explosive get-off against Tampa Bay, drawing praise from columnist Sam McDowell for a different look under Spags.

items.title: Buccaneers Rookie Rueben Bain Jr. Impresses in NFL Debut
items.one_line: Tampa Bay's 15th overall pick generated pressure on third down with his hump move in Saturday's preseason game against the Chiefs.

items.title: Chargers Tackle Rashawn Slater Returns to Practice in Limited Role
items.one_line: Jim Harbaugh confirmed Slater practiced limited Saturday after a patellar tendon tear that cost him 2025 and a recent knee flare-up; Tarheeb Still and Tre' Harris were also limited, Quentin Johnston and Brenen Thompson sat.

items.title: Chargers Test Pipkins at Left Guard in Training Camp Lineup
items.one_line: ESPN reported Slater at LT, Trey Pipkins at LG, rookie Jake Slaughter at center, Cole Strange at RG, and Joe Alt at RT after Tyler Biadasz's ACL injury opened the interior battle.

items.title: Cole Strange Struggles Spark Chargers Line Concerns in Preseason Loss
items.one_line: In a 41-17 preseason loss to San Francisco, Justin Herbert's first-team offense managed one completion for nine yards before a punt, with new right guard Cole Strange getting beat on back-to-back plays.

items.title: Dolphins Claim Rookie CB Jai’Onte’ McMillan Off Waivers from Colts
items.one_line: Miami claimed the undrafted TCU/Minnesota corner mid-game Saturday, releasing Nick McCloud to add secondary depth before cutdown day.

items.title: Odell Beckham Jr. Flashes Vintage Skills in Giants Preseason Rout
items.one_line: New York beat Miami 26-3 at Hard Rock Stadium; OBJ delivered jukes and a first-down catch after rejoining the Giants, as both clubs evaluated depth after 0-1 starts.

items.title: Giants Dominate Dolphins in Intense Joint Practice
items.one_line: On August 20 in South Florida, Jaxson Dart went 16-of-22 with a 50-yard bomb and the Giants defense logged over six sacks, with fights breaking out amid the physicality.

items.title: Ravens Rock New Uniforms in Vikings Preseason Clash
items.one_line: Minnesota hosted Baltimore in its only home preseason game at U.S. Bank Stadium on August 22, with starters like Lamar Jackson sitting after joint practices and both clubs debuting white jerseys.

items.title: Patriots Host Eagles in Second Preseason Clash at Gillette
items.one_line: New England welcomed Philadelphia to Foxborough on Saturday night, resting most starters after joint practices to evaluate depth in the final home preseason game.

items.title: Drake Maye Lands at No. 11 on NFL Top 100 Players of 2026
items.one_line: The player-voted list put Maye 11th after a 2025 season of 72% completions, 4,394 yards, 31 TDs, and eight picks, ahead of Patrick Mahomes at No. 18.

items.title: Saints Fans Split on Resting Starter Shough in Preseason
items.one_line: Kellen Moore has kept Tyler Shough and over 30 projected starters out of preseason games, using joint practices vs. Dallas and the Rams instead; critics note his limited experience and Alvin Kamara's injury.

items.title: Odell Beckham Jr. Flashes Vintage Skills in Giants Preseason Rout
items.one_line: OBJ shook defenders and snagged a first-down catch in New York's 26-3 preseason win over Miami at Hard Rock Stadium after rejoining the club earlier this year.

items.title: Giants Rest Dart, Tracy Fumbles in Dolphins Preseason Clash
items.one_line: Jaxson Dart sat while some starters played; Tyrone Tracy Jr. fumbled in the red zone on a wet ball amid backfield competition from Najee Harris as coaches evaluate final cuts.

items.title: Garrett Wilson's Route-Running Precision Shines in Jets' Preseason Shutout
items.one_line: Wilson's third-and-6 grab from Geno Smith, who went 7-for-7 on a 10-play TD drive, highlighted New York's 17-0 preseason win over Pittsburgh.

items.title: Eagles Rookie Jackson Hurt on Opening Kickoff vs. Patriots
items.one_line: Running back Ja’Quinden Jackson went down tackling on the opening kickoff Saturday at Gillette, showed movement in all extremities, and was taken to a hospital for checks.

items.title: Patriots Host Eagles in Second Preseason Clash at Gillette
items.one_line: Philadelphia visited Foxborough in white road jerseys Saturday night, resting most starters after joint practices to evaluate depth.

items.title: Steelers' Joey Porter Jr. Draws Trade Interest Amid Extension Stalemate
items.one_line: Jordan Schultz reported multiple teams inquiring as Porter Jr. enters his final rookie year and recovers from a back injury since late July; Steelers sources deny interest unless it would take multiple firsts.

items.title: Howard Struggles, Allar Shines in Steelers Preseason Shutout
items.one_line: Pittsburgh fell 17-0 to the Jets; Will Howard went 10-for-15 for 74 yards with two INTs, Drew Allar 11 of 23 for 110, and the club still plans four QBs on the 53 with Rodgers and Rudolph.

items.title: Steelers Fans Revive Frustration Over 2023 Broderick Jones Draft Pick
items.one_line: Jones gave up a sack and pressures against Jets rookie David Bailey in the 17-0 loss, fueling talk about whether the 2023 first-round tackle belongs on the Week 1 roster in his final rookie-deal year.

items.title: Seahawks Place Jake Bobo on Season-Ending Injured Reserve After Knee Injury
items.one_line: Seattle moved Bobo to IR Saturday after a serious knee injury in Friday's Titans joint practice in Nashville; Mike Macdonald called it long-term, and the club signed Julian Hicks.

items.title: Seahawks' Tory Horton Out with Undisclosed Injury Amid Receiver Woes
items.one_line: Mike Macdonald confirmed second-year WR Tory Horton will miss time after sitting the preseason opener and a full week of practice, stacking on Bobo's knee issue ahead of Week 1.

items.title: 49ers Rookie Stribling Impresses Before Shoulder Setback
items.one_line: Second-round WR De’Zhaun Stribling caught 11 passes for 109 yards in two exhibitions but is day-to-day with a shoulder injury that kept him out of practice, testing Week 1 availability vs. the Rams.

items.title: Buccaneers Rookie Rueben Bain Jr. Impresses in NFL Debut
items.one_line: The 15th overall pick from Miami generated third-down pressure with his hump move in Saturday's preseason game against Kansas City.

items.title: Chiefs Rookie R Mason Thomas Impresses in Preseason Debut
items.one_line: Kansas City's second-round edge deflected a third-down pass and showed burst against Tampa Bay in the same preseason matchup.

items.title: Seahawks' Jake Bobo Suffers Serious Knee Injury in Titans Practice
items.one_line: Bobo went down on his right leg Friday during a joint practice in Nashville; both clubs paused for prayer, and Mike Macdonald called it a serious knee issue.

items.title: Dan Quinn Says Commanders Must Figure Out Center After Preseason Loss
items.one_line: After a 17-13 loss to Detroit, Quinn praised Brandon Coleman (in for injured Laremy Tunsil) and Sam Cosmi but said center is unresolved among Nick Allegretti, rookie Matt Gulbin, and Julian Good-Jones.

items.title: Commanders Fans Say Rookie Kaliakmanis Secures QB3 Spot After Strong Preseason Outing
items.one_line: Seventh-rounder Athan Kaliakmanis went 11-for-14 for 162 yards with no turnovers in the Lions game and is 17-for-24 for 249 yards over two exhibitions, ahead of Sam Hartman.

items.title: Lions Edge Commanders 17-13 in Preseason Thriller with Daniels Debut
items.one_line: Jayden Daniels played three snaps (0-for-1, a sack) in his preseason debut alongside Terry McLaurin and Stefon Diggs as Detroit won 17-13.
